storm_surge: Storm surge of about 1-1.5-meter height above the astronomical tide inundated the low-lying areas of the coastal districts of north Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and adjoining south Andhra Pradesh during the time of landfall.

cyclone: Severe Cyclonic Storm “Shakthi” over northeast Arabian Sea (01Oct – 07th October, 2025)
max_wind_duration: from 0000 UTC to 12 UTC on 5th October, 2025
landfall_place: Weakened into a well-marked low-pressure area over southwest Arabian Sea on 7th October.
storm_surge: No surge was forecast and observed in association with this system

cyclone: Severe cyclonic storm “MONTHA” over Southeast Bay of Bengal (25th – 30th) October, 2025
landfall_place: Well Marked Low Pressure Area over east Vidarbha and adjoining south Chhattisgarh at 0000 UTC of 30th October 2025
storm_surge: Maximum storm surge of height about 0.8 m above astronomical tide has been reported in Kakinada around 0230 hours IST of 29th October in association with the landfall of the severe cyclonic storm “Montha” over Coastal Andhra Pradesh. The height of the tidal wave including storm surge and astronomical tide was about 2.2 m in that area as per the tide gauge measurements.

cyclone: Cyclonic Storm “SENYAR” over the Strait of Malacca (25-27 November, 2025)
landfall_place: Weakened into a well marked low pressure area over Malacca Strait and adjoining coastal areas of Malaysia in the midnight (2330 hrs IST/ 1800 UTC) of 27th Nov

cyclone: Cyclone “DITWAH” over Bay of Bengal (27th November – 03 December 2025)
max_wind_duration: from 0300 UTC on 29th November, 2025 to 0600 UTC on 30th November, 2025
landfall_place: Weakened into a Well Marked Low Pressure Area over North Tamil Nadu-Puducherry coasts and neighbourhood
storm_surge:
30.11.2025 /0300 UTC
Storm surge of height 0.5 m – 1.0 m above astronomical tide inundated low lying areas of coastal Tamil Nadu – Puducherry on 29th November. Significant wave height of 1.8 m was observed near Pamban bridge.
